title: Cancellation Fees, Package Size Changes and Points Eligibility on Tailwise Pharmacy Classes
content:
This Tailwise Pharmacy schedule covers what a cancellation costs, whether a prescriber's discontinuation takes effect at once, whether the package size may be switched, and whether fills earn Pals Rewards points.

| Class | Fee for cancelling a pending or undispensed order | Fee for cancelling a compounded fill after compounding started | Prescriber's discontinuation takes effect the day it is received | Package size may be switched without a new authorization | Fills earn Pals Rewards points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rx Prescription Diet | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Rx Controlled Substance | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes | No | No |
| Rx Compounded Medication | $0.00 | $12.50 | Yes | No | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Cancelling before dispensing**: the fee for cancelling a pending or undispensed order.
- **Cancelling after compounding started**: the fee for cancelling a compounded fill after compounding has started.
- **Discontinuation**: whether a prescriber's discontinuation takes effect the day it is received.
- **Package size switch**: whether the customer may switch to another package size of the same product and strength without a new authorization.
- **Points**: whether pharmacy fills earn Pals Rewards points.

## Points of reading

- No class charges for withdrawing a pending order; only a compounded fill cancelled after compounding started carries a fee, $12.50.
- Rx Controlled Substance fills earn no Pals Rewards points.
- Package sizes may be switched on Rx Preventive, Rx Maintenance Medication and Rx Prescription Diet prescriptions only.
